The tax provision moved in the same direction as the GAAP profit improvement, so it is not evidence of a smaller tax drag. All comparisons are sequential displayed-value arithmetic, not year-over-year, and no causal driver is established. Because the selected rows are incomplete and the drivers of the residual operating line, the recurring-to-transactional mix shift, and the GAAP versus adjusted divergence are unexplained, the thesis is maintained at its current conviction with no change to status; the research question remains open pending fuller filing detail, segment-level disclosure, and reconciliation of adjusted to GAAP measures.
